name: Chrono‑Bloom Garden
description: A garden where flowers bloom in accelerated time‑lapse, each stage frozen in a separate concentric ring.
prompt: Top‑down view of a circular garden divided into concentric rings. Each ring shows the same flower species at a different growth stage — seed, sprout, bud, full bloom, petal fall — all simultaneously present. Colors transition smoothly. Soft morning light, hyper‑detail, scientific illustration aesthetic blended with fantasy.
caption: All seasons in a single glance 🌱🌸 #ChronoBloom
